name: Hip Hike
steps: Stand sideways on the edge of a low sturdy box with your standing knee locked straight and your free leg hanging beside the box.
Keep your shoulders level, hands on your hips, and torso tall facing straight ahead.
Keep both legs straight as you slowly let the unsupported side of your pelvis drop.
Contract the outer hip of your standing leg to hike your free hip smoothly back up slightly above level, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your standing knee straight throughout so the motion isolates your outer hip rather than bending your knee.
Avoid leaning your upper body sideways to lift the hanging hip.
